normalized_source_planes: s_i.u=1+4*h, h in Z; u=x/(sqrt(3)*d), d>0

claims.statement: For d>0, the affine map x=sqrt(3)*d*((-1,1,1)+2*v) identifies the even-sum lattice with all vertices of the declared four-plane arrangement and carries its complete geometric chamber/face structure to the regular tetrahedral-octahedral tiling.
claims.acceptance: An inverse and all plane indices are explicit; classify every chamber through the sum-zero four-coordinate slice as a tetrahedron or octahedron; prove face incidence and twelve nearest-neighbor directions; compare the net's two templates with actual chambers.
claims.falsifier: An incorrect image/inverse, plane index, cell type, face identification or nearest-neighbor count under the fixed declared map.

claims.statement: Every two-coloring of the even-sum lattice contains an elementary tetrahedral or octahedral chamber whose vertices all have the same color.
claims.acceptance: Prove this one coloring splits every elementary chamber, not merely a bounded list; independently test tetrahedral and octahedral chambers and retain that even dilations are not refuted.
claims.falsifier: A monochromatic elementary chamber for the proposed parity coloring would reject this particular counterexample; it would not prove universal fixed-scale forcing.

controls: scale-two image called an elementary cell
scope_boundary: Geometric realization and a fixed-scale counterexample only. No native attachment/history admission, uniform Ramsey bound, physical proton identification or parent proof promotion. The dilation-allowing Ramsey pilot is not refuted.
